rationale: The agent correctly used the product tools to answer the non-account question about how many t-shirt options are available and provided a specific number based on the product details tool. When the user asked to modify pending orders, the agent followed policy by requesting identity verification (email or full name plus zip) and declined to proceed without it. The agent did not perform any writes, did not act on unverified orders, and appropriately offered secure alternative support channels. There were no unsupported claims or fabricated order information. While the modification request was not fulfilled, this was due to lack of verification, which aligns with policy, so the overall handling meets the pass bar.
